title: Sona promise: Lower power bills as VAT on system loss out

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) has removed the 12-percent value-added tax (VAT) on system loss charges in electricity bills effective immediately, a move the Department of Energy (DOE) earlier estimated may lower power costs for consumers by about 5 to 10 percent.
